name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for window replacement in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a window replacement contractor in the Bay Area, look for companies with strong local references, proper licensing and insurance, and a track record of quality workmanship. Ask for detailed quotes, inquire about warranties on both products and installation, and review their portfolio.
